text: {"features":[{"name":"Role understanding","description":"Shows how well the letter understands this job as building tooling and automation that scale security work across developer workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents the job as a generic software or security role, with little sign that the writer understands its emphasis on security tooling, automation, or internal developer workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Recognizes one broad aspect of the role, such as backend engineering or security impact, but leaves the team's specific operating model mostly unaddressed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the role to at least one concrete responsibility, such as secure defaults, vulnerability handling, or internal tooling for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Accurately ties several responsibilities together, such as scaling security work through automation, serving developer teams, and combining Go back ends with Python or AI."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of the role as systematizing scarce security expertise through agentic tooling, triage, analysis, and developer-facing infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Security motivation","description":"Conveys the depth and authenticity of the applicant's motivation to work specifically in security engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the opening with little evidence of a distinctive reason for wanting security work in particular."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a general desire for security impact or resilience but gives only limited personal grounding for that interest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a clear personal reason for preferring preventive or security-oriented engineering over generic feature work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames security engineering as a deliberate career direction, supported by convincing experience or philosophy about how systems fail."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys exceptional intrinsic commitment to security work with a memorable, deeply credible rationale for why preventive security matters."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"Shows how strongly the letter values foundational systems whose impact multiplies across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses on the role mainly as an individual engineering position rather than an opportunity to improve shared systems used by many teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or broad impact briefly, but organizational leverage is not a meaningful part of the case."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear interest in foundational systems or organization-wide leverage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames past work and desired impact in terms of improving shared infrastructure for many teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a central, persuasive theme, showing sophisticated appreciation for the multiplier effect of central security tooling."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"Shows empathy for the engineers who would use the team's tools and systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not address the developers or teams who would rely on the tools this role builds."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping other engineers in passing without showing real understanding of their constraints or behavior."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows awareness that the role serves other developers through automation, tooling, or safer workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes making the secure path easy, reducing friction, or building defaults that busy engineers will actually follow."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong empathy for internal users by linking security tooling to usability, proximity to engineers, and behavior change through low-friction systems."}]},{"name":"Partnership orientation","description":"Shows readiness to build security tooling in close collaboration with security specialists and internal stakeholders.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not indicate any appreciation for collaboration with security experts or internal users."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes only generic teamwork language that could apply to any engineering role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that effective tooling comes from working close to the people who use it or advise it."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly values proximity to internal users or security specialists and links that collaboration to better design choices."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes partnership a core part of the case, showing nuanced understanding that security automation succeeds only when built in close collaboration with experts and the teams it serves."}]},{"name":"Fit synthesis","description":"Connects the applicant's background into a coherent case for why they fit this specific role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a loose collection of credentials or interests with little synthesis into a role-specific case."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several relevant facts, but the argument for fit remains implicit or underdeveloped."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Builds a coherent case by linking multiple experiences to the role's needs."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Integrates background, motivations, and technical match into a clear, focused argument for fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a sharp, memorable, and highly role-specific case that makes it easy to see why this applicant belongs in the position."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"Indicates the strength of formal technical training relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only the baseline relevant academic preparation, typically a bachelor's degree presented without additional academic depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant bachelor's degree with some signal of especially strong formal grounding or theoretical preparation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant master's degree."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant master's degree with unusually advanced or research-oriented technical framing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant doctoral degree or similarly advanced research training."}]},{"name":"Experience depth","description":"Reflects the substance of the applicant's professional software engineering experience across testing, maintenance, and launch of production systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only basic production experience for this sample, with early-career scope and limited evidence of ownership across launched services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows modest but credible production experience, with some testing, maintenance, and launch work on a small number of services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience across the software lifecycle, with multiple services or clear growth in ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial experience over several years with repeated launches and sustained ownership of production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially deep experience for the sample, combining long tenure, multiple launches, and mature ownership across the product lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Go proficiency","description":"Shows how central and substantial the applicant's Go experience is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, without showing that it is a core working language."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates regular Go use but not major ownership or primary-language status."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a primary, daily, or mostly used language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Pairs primary Go use with clear ownership of production back-end or infrastructure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go a clear core strength, tied to substantial ownership of production systems that closely resemble the role's back-end work."}]},{"name":"Python proficiency","description":"Shows the depth and production relevance of the applicant's Python experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it too vaguely to judge."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly without clarifying scope, frequency, or significance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, scripts, or prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Python ownership in production services, automation layers, internal tools, or analyses."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major strength across services, automation, and agent logic, often with signals of quality such as testing, typing, or heavy team dependence."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"Shows hands-on experience applying AI or LLMs in a way relevant to production engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not provide meaningful evidence of hands-on AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References AI at a high level or as an interest area without clear implementation experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on work with model-backed or LLM-based features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience with explicit learning about evaluation, reliability, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial, production-minded AI experience in which trustworthiness, evaluation, and operational behavior are treated as first-class concerns."}]},{"name":"Agent design","description":"Shows experience designing systems in which autonomous agents operate within controlled boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic systems or bounded autonomous behavior."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or AI agents vaguely without showing architecture or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent-based tooling or pipelines at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how agent responsibilities are divided across components, such as Python agents paired with Go services for control or audit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Gives a crisp, technically credible agent architecture that emphasizes contracts, permissions, auditability, or hard boundaries around autonomous actions."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Shows relevant experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability intake, triage, or handling work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation in general without tying it to vulnerability workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that they automated vulnerability intake, triage, or queue handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete workflow capabilities such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or owner assignment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature operational thinking about vulnerability automation by turning a manual process into a reliable pipeline and explaining the capacity or time it created."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"Shows direct experience performing security reviews, assessments, or threat modeling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no firsthand evidence of security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest through general language or credentials but gives no clear assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Says they performed security reviews, assessments, or threat models."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment methods such as attack-surface mapping, attacker-style code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a substantive engineering practice across systems, with concrete methods and a builder's perspective on what findings mean."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Shows the strength of the applicant's data structures and algorithms ability as applied to real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms in any meaningful way."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength only in generic terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one practical example of using better data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows confident fluency through specific examples like graph algorithms, scheduling, indexing, lookup redesigns, or bottleneck removal."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking a standout strength, using technically credible examples that materially improved performance, tractability, or correctness."}]},{"name":"Security self-development","description":"Shows sustained investment in learning security and adversarial thinking outside assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no meaningful evidence of security learning or adversarial practice beyond normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a light external signal, such as a baseline certification or occasional competition participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful external development through either a rigorous credential or sustained adversarial practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals of ongoing security growth, such as serious competition results, repeated hands-on practice, or a demanding credential."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional commitment to sharpening security craft outside regular duties, with rigorous hands-on training and clearly deliberate ongoing practice."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"Shows contribution to or maintenance of open-source software that others use.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or casual contributions with little sense of ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular upstream fixes or maintenance of a small project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows maintainer-level responsibility for an actively used project, including review, releases, or roadmap ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates sustained stewardship of an open-source project or framework used beyond the writer's immediate team, with clear community-facing responsibility."}]},{"name":"Project rigor","description":"Shows the ambition and technical depth of self-directed engineering projects outside core job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention a self-directed project, or mentions one too slight to reveal much technical depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a modest side project with limited complexity or unclear engineering challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a finished self-directed project that shows end-to-end ownership or some systems thinking."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a technically demanding infrastructure or distributed-systems project with explicit attention to failure cases, consistency, or recovery."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional ambition in personal engineering through a production-like project built to confront hard systems problems in depth."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"Shows how clearly the letter explains the results of the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly lists technologies or responsibilities without stating what changed because of the work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies useful work but leaves outcomes vague or purely qualitative."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States clear positive effects such as reduced manual work, improved speed, or better resilience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties accomplishments to meaningful operational outcomes for a team or users, such as freed expert time or routine handling of a once-painful process."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes impact highly convincing through quantified results or vivid before-and-after descriptions that clearly show why the work mattered."}]},{"name":"Specificity","description":"Shows how concrete and well-supported the letter's claims are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mainly on broad claims and adjectives with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some concrete background facts but describes most achievements in general terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several specific examples of systems, responsibilities, or technical choices."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is consistently concrete, with enough detail to judge scope, method, and credibility across most major claims."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is unusually specific and credible throughout, using precise examples, architecture details, and context to substantiate nearly every major point."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"Shows a disciplined approach to correctness, reliability, boundaries, and production standards in security-sensitive systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little evidence of a careful approach to correctness, boundaries, reliability, or production discipline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions reliability or quality in passing without concrete supporting detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one concrete signal of disciplined engineering, such as testing, failure-mode thinking, typed code, or explicit guardrails."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly emphasizes dependable systems, production standards, bounded behavior, or recovery logic in a credible way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes rigor a defining theme of the letter, consistently showing concern for correctness, failure handling, auditable boundaries, and standards appropriate for security-sensitive systems."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"Shows the degree of grammatical correctness, spelling accuracy, and sentence-level professionalism in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or wording errors materially distract from comprehension or professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors or awkward constructions are present, though the letter remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Occasional mistakes appear, but the prose is generally clear and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Writing is polished and easy to read, with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Prose is exceptionally clean, fluent, and professional, with virtually no distracting errors."}]}]}
